hero.credit: Eighteenth-Century Indian Muraqqaʿs (Chapter 2) [1] - The art is originally thought to be a hunting scene with Hawks, but Friederike Weis argues in Eighteenth-Century Indian Muraqqaʿs (pg 30-31) that it is instead a large encampment scene of Muhammad Shah and the Mughal army at Sirhind in 1748 against the Afghans.
